name: Zeta (Balšić lordship)
alt: Lordship of Zeta and the Coast

predecessors.name: Serbian Empire
predecessors.text: Zeta and the western lands of Emperor Urosh: the Balsic had been 'rulers of the state under Tsar Urosh' from 1360 and 'created a regional principality sometime after 1360'; after Marica 'Emperor…

successors.name: Moravian Serbia
successors.text: Zeta, which Balsa III 'passed' to his uncle Despot Stefan Lazarevic in 1421; 'after its incorporation into the Serbian Despotate in 1421, Zeta was organized as a single large Vlast'

rulers.name: Đurađ II Balšić
rulers.title: Lord of Zeta and the Coast

ledger.x: 1371: the Balsic hold Zeta on their own.
c.1373: Đurađ I takes the coast beyond the Bay of Kotor from Nikola Altomanović.
1377: Tvrtko I annexes the coast.
c.1378: Vuk Branković takes Prizren and the Kosovo land.
By 1385: Balša II holds Durrës.
18 September 1385: Karl Thopia recovers Durrës after Savra.
1386 (bridge): Pal Dukagjini takes Lezhë and the Drin area.
1386 (bridge): the Jonima family secedes with its lands.
1386 (bridge): Onogošt goes to Venice.
After 1386 (bridge 1387): the castellan of Budva and his brother secede with the city.
March 1391: Đurađ II seizes Kotor.
Late 1392 (bridge): while Đurađ II is a prisoner, Radič Crnojević takes the Kotor lands.
Early 1393: Ottoman squadrons occupy Scutari and Drivast.
April 1396: Đurađ II hands Scutari to Venice.
1396: the Ottomans no longer hold Scutari.
1405: Venice seizes Ulcinj, Bar and Budva.
1412: Balsa III retakes Bar.
1418: Balsa III retakes Shkodër.

1421, after Balša III's death on 28 April: 'Later that year, the Republic of Venice took advantage of Balša's death and seized the towns of Bar and Ulcinj,' and 'some of his other territories were seized by the Ottomans and Bosnians' (the page names Balša III as the one who died in 1421).
1421: Zeta passes to Stefan Lazarević.

wars.name: Battle of Savra
wars.outcome: Balsa II, defeated and killed on 18 September 1385 'near Berat in battle against the Turks'; Đurađ II succeeds; Thopia recovers Durres.

wars.name: Ottoman invasion of Zeta (Đurađ II)
wars.outcome: The Sultan's army invaded in May 1392; Đurađ II was captured in late 1392 and ransomed; Ottoman squadrons occupied the places in early 1393.

wars.name: Balsa III's war with Venice (First Scutari War)
wars.outcome: Venice seized Ulcinj, Bar and Budva in 1405; Balsa III retook Bar in 1412 and Shkodër in 1418 and failed at Budva in 1419.

certainty.note: No treaty line is given on any page opened; Zeta's borders follow the towns held (Scutari, Ulcinj, Bar, Kotor) and the Venetian frontier moves with them.
